page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Printed page number at top right. Running head at top centre. Signature mark at foot left of centre.

main_text.head: Conjuga verba Mediæ formæ.
Primum præsens tempus.
main_text.l: Τύπτομαι, verbero vel verberor, τύπτῃ, τύπτεται.
τυπτόμεσθον, τύπτεσθον, τύπτεσθον.
τυπτόμεθα, τύπτεσθε, τύπτονται, ut in forma passiva.
Τίθεμαι, pono vel ponor, τίθεσαι, &c.
Ἵσταμαι, ἵστασαι, ἵσταται, &c.
Δίδομαι, δίδοσαι, δίδοται, &c.
main_text.head: Secundum præsens tempus.
main_text.l: Εἴθε τυπτέωμαι, utinam verberem vel verberer, τυπτέῳ, &c.
Εἴθε θέωμαι, utinam ponam vel ponar, θέω, θέῃ.
θεώμεθον, θέασθον, θέασθω.
θεώμεθα, θέασθε, θέωνται, ut in forma passiva nisi quòd ι in principio abiiciatur.
Εἴθε στῶμαι, utinam fistam vel fistar στῶ, στῇ, ut in forma passiva, nisi quòd ι in principio tollatur.
Εἴθε διδῶμαι, utinam tradam vel tradar, διδῶ, διδῷ, ut in forma passiva, nisi quòd δι in principio tollatur.
main_text.head: Tertium præsens tempus.
main_text.l: Ἐὰν τυπτῶμαι, si verberem vel verberer, τυπτῇ, &c.
Ἐὰν θῶμαι, si ponam vel ponar, θῇ, θῆται, ut in forma passiva, ν in principio abjecto.
Ἐὰν στῶμαι, si fistam vel fistar, στῇ, στῆται, &c.
Ἐὰν διδῶμαι, si tradam vel tradar, διδῶ, διδῶται, ut in forma passiva, nisi quòd δι in principio tollatur.
main_text.p: Interdum sunt imperfecti temporis, verba secundi vel tertii præsentis.
main_text.head: Imperfectum tempus.
main_text.l: Ἐτυπτόμην, verberabam vel verberabar, ἐτύπτου, &c.
Ἐτιθέμην, ponebam vel ponebar, ἐτίθεσο, &c.
Ἱστάμην, fistebam vel fistebar, ἵστασο, ἱστῶ, &c.
Ἐδιδόμην, tradebam vel tradebar, ἐδίδοσο, &c.
main_text.head: Primum perfectum tempus.
main_text.l: Τέτυπται, τέτυψαι, τέτυπται.
τετύφθον, τετύφθον.
τετύφθαμεν, τετύφθε, τετύφθαν.

page.notes: Greek forms are small and partly worn; accents and breathings in the Greek lines are not fully legible and were copied as best seen. The perfect-tense forms in the last lines are doubtful and should be checked against the scan. The forms with "&c." are printed that way. The header "GRAECA." is the running head and the "183" is the page number.
